en.hero.subtitle: From Marmaris to the Black Sea, over 18 years of experience delivering premium standards in accommodation, transport and guided services.
en.dest.title: Designed for you
en.dest.copy: We bring culture, history, nature and comfort together to create exceptional travel experiences.
en.about.title: Premium journeys shaped by local expertise
en.about.p1: For 18 years under Invaders Tourism, backed by more than 40 years in the industry, we have designed seamless journeys across Turkey.
en.about.p2: From transportation and accommodation to guiding and private tours, we manage every need from one point and make each journey personal, warm and safe.
en.services.title: We design your journey from start to finish
en.services.copy: From a single booking to complex group operations, our experienced team manages every detail.
en.services.s1.title: Transportation
en.services.s1.desc: Comfortable and reliable VIP transfers, car rental and group transport.
en.services.s2.title: Accommodation
en.services.s2.desc: Options tailored to your style and budget, from boutique hotels to luxury resorts.
en.services.s3.title: Individual Booking
en.services.s3.desc: Fully personalized travel programs shaped around your preferences.
en.services.s4.title: Group Booking
en.services.s4.desc: Coordinated organization and advantageous planning for private or corporate groups.
en.services.s5.title: Business Meetings
en.services.s5.desc: Professional transport, accommodation and operational support for your guests.
en.regions.title: With you on Turkey's finest routes
en.regions.copy: From coastlines and highlands to ancient cities and modern metropolises, we unite every experience under one premium standard.
en.regions.r1.name: Istanbul
en.regions.r1.desc: A unique blend of the Bosphorus, history and modern city life.
en.regions.r2.name: Cappadocia
en.regions.r2.desc: Balloons, valleys and extraordinary rock formations.
en.regions.r3.name: Rize
en.regions.r3.desc: Lush highlands, tea gardens and misty views of the Kaçkar Mountains.
en.regions.r4.name: Ephesus & Aegean
en.regions.r4.desc: Ancient civilizations, quiet coves and olive-scented roads.
en.tours.title: Routes created exclusively for you
en.tours.t1.title: Private Marmaris Boat Tour
en.tours.t1.desc: Explore the Aegean from the sea with hidden bays, quiet beaches and a private itinerary.
en.tours.t2.title: Premium Cappadocia Experience
en.tours.t2.desc: Boutique accommodation, private transfers, valley routes and a sunrise balloon experience.
en.tours.t3.title: Black Sea & Rize Route
en.tours.t3.desc: Discover Rize, Ayder and selected stops around Uzungöl with an expert guide.
en.promise.title: Your comfort begins before the journey does.
en.promise.copy: From planning and welcoming to accommodation and return transfer, we remain your single point of contact.
en.contact.title: Let's design your next journey together
en.contact.copy: Tell us briefly what you need and our team will contact you with suitable routes and service options.
en.contact.address: İnönü Mah. Cumhuriyet Cad. Şakir Paşa Apt. No:59/11 Şişli/Istanbul

en.form.successMsg: We will contact you as soon as possible.
en.footer.desc: Personalized, reliable and premium tourism services throughout Turkey.

ar.hero.subtitle: من مرمريس إلى البحر الأسود، أكثر من 18 عامًا من الخبرة في تقديم خدمات إقامة ونقل وإرشاد بمعايير فاخرة.
ar.dest.title: نصممها خصيصًا لك
ar.dest.copy: نجمع الثقافة والتاريخ والطبيعة والراحة لنقدم تجارب سفر استثنائية.
ar.about.title: رحلات فاخرة بخبرة محلية
ar.about.p1: منذ 18 عامًا تحت مظلة إنفيدرز للسياحة، وبخبرة تتجاوز 40 عامًا في القطاع، نصمم رحلات سلسة في جميع أنحاء تركيا.

ar.services.title: نصمم رحلتك من البداية إلى النهاية
ar.services.copy: من حجز فردي إلى تنظيم المجموعات، يدير فريقنا الخبير كل التفاصيل.
ar.services.s1.title: النقل
ar.services.s1.desc: نقل VIP وتأجير سيارات ونقل جماعي مريح وموثوق.
ar.services.s2.title: الإقامة
ar.services.s2.desc: خيارات تناسب أسلوبك وميزانيتك من الفنادق البوتيكية إلى المنتجعات الفاخرة.
ar.services.s3.title: الحجز الفردي
ar.services.s3.desc: برامج سفر شخصية بالكامل وفقًا لتفضيلاتك.
ar.services.s4.title: الحجز الجماعي
ar.services.s4.desc: تنظيم منسق وتخطيط مميز للمجموعات الخاصة أو الشركات.
ar.services.s5.title: اجتماعات العمل
ar.services.s5.desc: دعم احترافي للنقل والإقامة والعمليات لضيوفكم.
ar.regions.title: معكم في أجمل مسارات تركيا
ar.regions.copy: من السواحل والهضاب إلى المدن القديمة والحديثة، نوحد كل تجربة تحت معيار فاخر واحد.
ar.regions.r1.name: إسطنبول

ar.regions.r2.name: كابادوكيا
